messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — marketplace release window next week. Need final sign-off on driver/CUDA/ROCm pins and partner hotpatch playbook. Can we do a quick preflight here?

sam.k: +1. What do we need to lock today vs what can be staged post-launch?

lee_j: Short list: 1) exact driver/CUDA/ROCm versions we ship with images 2) canary rollout cadence for marketplace 3) hotfix cadence & contact matrix for HW partners 4) SI installer packaging constraints (airgap, KMS)

anita: For SI installs: we need an offline bundle and the checksum manifest. Also confirm HSM/KMS cert rotation won't break driver reload on boot.

maria.g: Proposed compatibility matrix (draft):
```
CUDA: 12.2.1
Driver: 535.86.05
ROCm: 5.5.3
```
These are the versions validated in internal perf runs. If partners require a different driver minor, we should plan a pinned fallback image.

sam.k: Can we avoid dual-image explosion? Suggest main image pinned to the above + a small "compat-fallback" variant with 535.65 and ROCm 5.5.2 for older partners. Only enable fallback by routing policy.

lee_j: Agreed. Fallback only used by smart-routing when partner region / HW reports kernel error patterns. Docs should list the signal set that triggers fallback (OOMs, kernel oops, nvml crashes).

anita: SI asks: how will we surface hotpatches? They want a simple patch bundle (driver modules + install script). We need an approved signing key for air-gapped installs. Ops: who owns packaging?

ops-runner: packaging = eng-infra + eng-runtime. I can own release artifacts and the manifest. Need a signer from security (cc-ing later). Canary windows: Wed 0200-0600 UTC next week.

maria.g: Marketplace comms: we have an embargo until Tuesday EOD. Jordan, legal/marketing coordination?

jordan_r: On it. Draft press note and partner-facing bulletin will be ready Monday. We need final pinned matrix by 09:00 PT Monday to include in partner bulletin. Also confirm support SLA wording for hotpatches (48h for critical regressions?).

sam.k: 48h seems tight for kernel/driver hotfixes depending on vendor turnaround. Recommend 72h target for vendor stack issues, 48h for our runtime-level hotfixes.

anita: We'll document the escalation path: Redwood on-call -> partner NRE -> vendor driver team. Include contact matrix and expected SLAs.

maria.g: deploy-bot, can you run the quick compatibility smoke for the pinned set and post CI results here?

deploy-bot: CI run triggered: compat-smoke/pinned-1766023456. Tests: basic inference, multi-GPU KV cache, driver reload. ETA ~18m.

ops-runner: I'll also run the marketplace image build with fallback tagging and push to staging registry after CI green.

deploy-bot: CI completed: 14/14 tests passed. No kernel oops in smoke. Perf delta vs baseline: +0.8% latency at p95. Artifacts: gs://redwood-ci/compat-smoke/1766023456

lee_j: Nice. Can we capture the telemetry keys that would trigger routing to fallback? e.g. nvml memory error, nvlink timeout, kernel panic string. I'll put a short policy in the routing config.

maria.g: Action items summary:
- sam.k: finalize fallback image build & routing flag (owner)
- ops-runner: push marketplace staging image + manifest (owner)
- anita: package SI offline bundle + signing plan (owner)
- jordan_r: finalize partner bulletin + embargo plan (owner)
- eng-runtime: update routing policy and fallback signals (owners: lee_j + sam.k)
Deadline: Monday 09:00 PT.

sam.k: I'll have the PR up by Sunday EOD.

anita: Working on offline bundle checklist; will need security to sign artifacts Monday morning.

jordan_r: Partner bulletin draft in #marketing-private for review. Will loop in legal.

maria.g: Thanks all. If anything blocks the 09:00 PT cutoff shout here. Otherwise we proceed with canary per ops-runner window. :rocket:

lee_j: Noted — I'll add the routing policy snippet to the repo and tag the PR with "marketplace-preflight"

ops-runner: Staging image push scheduled for Tue 02:15 UTC canary slot assuming no late changes.

maria.g: Closing thread — will open follow-up if vendors report regressions during canary. Good work. :thumbsup:
